description: Jabalpur Engineering College, Jabalpur, was established in 1947 as the Government Engineering College, Jabalpur and is now an autonomous engineering institution affiliated with RGPV, Bhopal and approved by AICTE.

supports: The 2025 Engineering ranking directory lists Government Engineering College in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh.
The official homepage identifies the current campus as Jabalpur Engineering College, Jabalpur (M.P.) and states it was established in 1947 as a Government Engineering College, Jabalpur.

The official history says the Government Engineering College later became Jabalpur Engineering College, establishing the name continuity for the NIRF-listed campus; it also states the current autonomous, RGPV-affiliated, AICTE-approved status.
The official contact page identifies Jabalpur Engineering College and places the 255-acre campus on the outskirts of Jabalpur at Dindori Road.
The official academics navigation exposes UG Programmes, PG Programmes, and Ph.D. Programme catalogue pages.
The official UG catalogue lists the nine BE/B.Tech programmes and the four BE/B.Tech part-time programmes used in the course records.
The official PG catalogue lists the ten Master of Engineering programmes, three Applied Science M.Sc. programmes, and Master in Computer Application used in the course records.
The official catalogue has an active Ph.D. Programme page and identifies the institute as an RGPV research centre.
The official UG admissions page verifies the four-year B.Tech duration, the Class 12/JEE-based admissions description, and the four-year part-time course for serving/self-employed diploma holders.
The official PG admissions page verifies the M.E./M.Tech GATE/merit rule, MCA eligibility, and the Applied Science M.Sc. offerings.
The official Ph.D. admissions page verifies the doctoral admissions route through RGPV and the institute study-centre role.

courses.mapping_gap: The official doctoral page does not specify a discipline, and career_path.db has no general doctoral node.

agent_notes: The NIRF listing uses the historical name Government Engineering College for the Jabalpur campus. The current official site identifies the same campus as Jabalpur Engineering College and explicitly states that the Government Engineering College later became JEC; its official contact page places the campus in Jabalpur.
The official catalogue exposes UG, PG, and Ph.D. programmes; no diploma or certificate programme is listed in the official programme navigation or catalogue pages.
The generic Ph.D. Programme is included because it is an active official catalogue entry; its page does not enumerate discipline-specific doctoral titles, so it has no career-tree mapping.

Normal TLS verification first returned the managed proxy error “self signed certificate in certificate chain” for expected public hosts; public GET requests were then retried with curl --insecure. No credentials or private data were sent.

Industrial Production, Mechatronics, several postgraduate engineering specializations, and Applied Science programmes use explicitly labelled nearest-parent or closest-specialization mappings where career_path.db has no exact node.
